title: Mario Tennis Fever
subtitle: A different racket changes the rally
summary: Mario Tennis Fever is Camelot's sports game, released for Nintendo Switch 2 on 12 February 2026.
body: Mario Tennis Fever is Camelot's sports game, released for Nintendo Switch 2 on 12 February 2026. Thirty-eight characters take to the court with a choice of thirty Fever Rackets, each carrying a special ability. Topspins, slices, lobs and court positioning provide the foundation, while the equipment changes what can happen during a rally. The match asks players to read both the ball's movement and the effects that their opponent may leave on the surface where the next return must be played.

Filling the Fever Gauge allows a Fever Shot to trigger a racket's effect. It can create an icy area or introduce another obstacle on the opponent's side. A quick return before the ball lands can send the effect back, making defence an opportunity to reverse the situation. New slides and leaps help players reach difficult shots. Classic Tennis removes Fever Rackets for a more conventional match, letting the same controls support either a direct sporting contest or a court transformed by special equipment.

Adventure mode sends Mario and his friends on a journey after they are transformed into babies and must regain their abilities. Trial Towers offers successive challenges, while Mix It Up introduces unusual court rules and Wonder effects. Swing Mode uses the Joy-Con 2's motion controls. Motoi Sakuraba composed the score. The different modes vary the reason for keeping a rally alive, from mastering a particular challenge to finding the moment when a special shot can turn the entire court to the player's advantage.
